dialogues.speaker: Elphane
dialogues.text: I'm Elphane, the guide for this trip.

dialogues.speaker: Elphane
dialogues.text: Melusines are a young race born in Fontaine. There are many differences between us and humanity.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything else about Melusines...

dialogues.speaker: Elphane
dialogues.text: We do have one secret that we can share with you, passenger.

dialogues.speaker: Elphane
dialogues.text: We are similar to humans in one way. Each of us has a different personality. Some of us like chatting. Some don't.
